name: AI Builder
author: Enki

sections.description:
WordPress AI Builder transforms the way you create websites by embedding AI-powered tools directly into the Gutenberg editor. Whether you’re starting from scratch or enhancing existing content, our plugin helps you generate full pages, content blocks, text, and images using simple prompts — all without writing a single line of code.

🔍 What You Can Do with WordPress AI Builder

  • Generate complete pages from a single prompt
  • Create entire Gutenberg blocks using AI (headings, text, images…)
  • Write high-quality text for paragraphs, CTAs, and descriptions
  • Generate AI-powered images directly into image blocks
  • Fully customize blocks after generation with native Gutenberg controls
  • Compress generated images automatically for faster loading, without quality loss

This plugin is perfect for freelancers, agencies, marketers, and anyone who wants to build professional WordPress sites faster — with no design or copywriting skills required.

Key Features

  • 🧠 Full Page Generation – Describe your page and let the AI build it.
  • 📦 Smart Block Creation – Turn prompts into reusable Gutenberg blocks.
  • ✍️ AI Text Generation – Write paragraphs, descriptions, and more instantly.
  • 🖼️ AI Image Generation – Create unique images that are compressed for web performance.
  • 🎨 100% Customizable – Every block remains editable with Gutenberg controls.
  • ⚡ Fast & Lightweight – Optimized for performance.

Credits

Developed by enkicorbin
Powered by modern AI APIs and built natively for WordPress and Gutenberg.

Support

For support, documentation, and feature requests, please visit our website: https://wordpress-ai-builder.com
Thank you for choosing WordPress AI Builder!
sections.installation:
1. Install AI Builder via the WordPress.org plugin directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Create an account
  4. Start using the AI tools in your Gutenberg editor
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key to use AI features?

No, you just need an account and credits to use AI generation features. The plugin will guide you through setup.

Can I edit the content after it’s generated?

Absolutely! All AI-generated pages, blocks, text, and images remain fully editable like any regular Gutenberg content.

Are images optimized for the web?

Yes. Images generated by AI are automatically compressed without affecting visual quality.

Can I use this with page builders like Elementor or Divi?

No. This plugin is built specifically for the native Gutenberg editor.

How do I get support?

You can reach out via the plugin support forum or visit our website for documentation and contact options.
